explication: SnapDOM captures a rendered DOM subtree into a reusable frozen result, then exposes image, canvas, Blob, and download outputs. Its plugin package extends that result with HTML/context/agent-map exports, document formats, and live recordings; vector export also produces editable artwork and Figma payloads. The core capture stages and major plugin branches are represented, but several plugin internals were not sampled, so their links rely on README capability statements rather than inferred call chains.
